NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on 2024-01-15 ("Effective Date") by and between:

DISCLOSING PARTY:
TechCorp Pvt Ltd
123 Tech Park, Bangalore 560001
("Disclosing Party")

AND

RECEIVING PARTY:
John Doe
456 Residential Area, Bangalore 560002
("Receiving Party")

RECITALS:

WHEREAS, the Disclosing Party possesses certain confidential and proprietary information;
WHEREAS, the Receiving Party desires to receive such confidential information for the purpose of evaluating potential business collaboration in AI technology;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
   
   1.1 "Confidential Information" means all technical data, source code, algorithms, business strategies, customer lists, and proprietary information disclosed by TechCorp
   
   1.2 Confidential Information shall not include information that:
       (a) Is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement;
       (b) Was rightfully in the Receiving Party's possession prior to disclosure;
       (c) Is independently developed by the Receiving Party;
       (d) Is rightfully obtained from a third party without breach.

2. OBLIGATIONS OF RECEIVING PARTY
   
   2.1 The Receiving Party agrees to:
       (a) Maintain the confidentiality of all Confidential Information;
       (b) Use the Confidential Information solely for evaluating potential business collaboration in AI technology;
       (c) Not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without prior written consent;
       (d) Protect Confidential Information with the same degree of care used for its own confidential information.

3. TERM
   
   This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for a period of 3 years.

4. RETURN OF MATERIALS
   
   Upon termination or upon request, the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information.

5. REMEDIES
   
   The parties acknowledge that breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm, and the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief.

6. GOVERNING LAW
   
   This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Karnataka.

7. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
   
   This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding confidentiality.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

DISCLOSING PARTY:                    RECEIVING PARTY:

_________________________            _________________________
TechCorp Pvt Ltd              John Doe

Date: ___________________            Date: ___________________
